scene: Your glowing brushstroke unlocks the service door, revealing three hidden transport passages.
picture: Flat side view of an expansive junction behind the marked door. On the left sits an open iron service elevator cage. Center-left stands the curly-haired boy holding his dripping brush. In the centre floats a small wooden rowing boat in a narrow canal. On the far right waits a wide steel freight lift.
shown: a metal service elevator with open lattice gate on the left
a wooden rowing boat moored in glowing water in the centre
a heavy steel freight lift with an illuminated green arrow on the right
